signin_ok.title: Sign in with a test account and land on the list
signin_ok.pre: None. You have the shared password from the project owner.
steps: Open https://ehire.shso.online/ in a browser.
Type the username test.nic.requester and the password, then press “[[login.submit]]”.
Look at the page and the top bar.
Press “[[nav.logout]]”. Sign in again as test.nic.accountant and look at the same things.
exp: The page “[[list.title]]” opens. Your full name shows in the top bar (test names end with “(δοκιμή)”).
The requester lands on the tab “[[list.tab.mine]]”. The accountant lands on the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]”.
Both see the button “[[list.new]]”. Only the accountant sees “[[list.export]]”.
Neither account sees “[[nav.audit]]” or “[[nav.settings]]” in the menu. No account asks you to change the password.

signin_bad.title: Wrong password and unknown username give the same message
steps: On the sign-in page type test.nic.requester and a wrong password. Press “[[login.submit]]”.
Type a username that does not exist (for example nobody) and any password. Press “[[login.submit]]”.
exp: Both attempts stay on the sign-in page and show “[[login.failed]]”.
The message does not say whether the username or the password was wrong.

signin_lock.title: Five failed attempts lock the username
who: Substitute of Primary Health Care: test.phc.deputy (no other case uses it)
signin_lock.pre: Use test.phc.deputy only. The lock lasts 15 minutes. If you cannot wait, ask the server administrator to run “flask unlock-user test.phc.deputy”.
steps: Type test.phc.deputy and a wrong password. Repeat four more times (five failures in total).
Look at the message after each attempt.
Type the correct password straight away.
After 15 minutes (or after the administrator unlocks the name), sign in with the correct password.
exp: Attempts 1 to 4 show “[[login.failed]]”.
Attempt 5 shows “[[login.locked|n=15]]”.
The correct password is refused with the same “Too many failed attempts” message while the lock lasts.
After the lock ends, sign-in works. The audit log (see the audit case) holds the events login_failed and login_locked.

signin_protect.title: Pages need a sign-in, and sign-out ends the session
steps: Type https://ehire.shso.online/requests/new in the address bar.
Sign in as test.nic.requester.
Press “[[nav.logout]]”.
Type https://ehire.shso.online/requests in the address bar.
exp: Step 1 shows the sign-in page, not the form.
After signing in you land on the form “[[form.title.new]]” (the page you asked for).
Step 3 shows the sign-in page.
Step 4 shows the sign-in page again. No request data is visible.

signin_lang.title: Switch the language and keep it after signing out
steps: Sign in. Press “English” at the top right.
Open the list, a request and the form “[[form.title.new]]”.
Press “[[nav.logout]]”, then sign in again.
Press “Ελληνικά”.
exp: Every screen label changes at once (for example “[[list.title]]”). Text typed by users and names in the test lists stay as they are.
After signing in again the language is still English, because it is stored on the user.
“Ελληνικά” switches everything back to Greek. The sign-in page also shows both language links.

form_open.title: The new request form and its lists
steps: Press “[[list.new]]”.
Look at the Directorate field and open the list “[[field.facility]]”.
Choose the category “[[category.nursing]]”, then open the list “[[field.position]]”.
Look at the section “[[form.section.documents]]”.
Sign out. Sign in as test.central.hr, press “[[list.new]]” and open the Directorate list.
exp: The page “[[form.title.new]]” has the sections “[[form.section.post]]”, “[[form.section.reason]]”, “[[form.section.need]]” and “[[form.section.documents]]”, and a panel with the route on the side.
The requester has only one Directorate, so it is already chosen (Nicosia). The facility list holds only Nicosia facilities.
After the category is chosen the position list holds only nursing positions.
The documents section says “[[docs.draft_first]]”.
The central officer can choose any of the six active Directorates (central roles may create requests).

form_category.title: Fields that depend on the staff category
steps: Choose the category “[[category.medical]]” and look for “[[field.oay_specialty]]” and “[[field.external_funding_flag]]”.
Choose “[[category.allied]]” and look again.
Choose “[[category.nursing]]”, then “[[category.admin]]”, then “[[category.other]]” and look again.
If a field does not appear or disappear, press “[[form.refresh_route]]”.
exp: Medical and allied health show the list “[[field.oay_specialty]]” and the question “[[field.external_funding_flag]]” (answers “[[answer.no]]” and “[[answer.yes]]”).
Nursing, administrative and other show neither field.
A field that is hidden is not required and is not stored.

form_reason.title: Fields that depend on the reason, and the leaver rows
steps: Choose the category “[[category.medical]]” and the reason “[[reason.new_need]]”. Look at the fields that appear.
Change the category to “[[category.nursing]]” and look again.
Choose the reason “[[reason.resignation]]”. Look at the block “[[field.leaver_name]]”. Open the list “[[field.employment]]”.
With “[[field.positions_count]]” 1, press “[[action.add_leaver]]” to get a second row. Fill both rows and press “[[form.submit]]”.
Set the posts to 2, press “[[action.add_leaver]]”, then “[[form.remove_leaver]]” on one row.
exp: New need shows “[[field.new_need_origin]]” and “[[field.new_need_cover_so_far]]”. For medical it also shows “[[field.new_need_plan]]”; for nursing it does not.

A departure reason shows one row with “[[field.leaver_name]]”, “[[field.leave_date]]” and “[[field.employment]]” (options “[[employment.okypy_contract]]” and “[[employment.civil_servant]]”) and hides the new need fields.
Two rows for one post give the error “[[validation.leavers_max]]”.
“[[form.remove_leaver]]” appears only when there is more than one row.

form_yesno.title: Follow-up text after a Yes answer
form_yesno.pre: On the form, with the category “[[category.medical]]”.
steps: Answer “[[field.absence_flag]]” with “[[answer.yes]]”.
Answer “[[field.external_funding_flag]]” with “[[answer.yes]]”.
Fill every other field and leave the two new text fields empty. Press “[[form.submit]]”.
Change both answers back to “[[answer.no]]”.
exp: “[[form.absence_detail]]” and “[[form.external_funding_detail]]” appear after Yes and are required: the form shows “[[validation.required]]” for each.
After No both fields disappear.

form_preview.title: The route preview follows Directorate and category
steps: As test.nic.requester choose the category “[[category.medical]]” and read the panel “[[tracker.preview_title]]”.
Change the category to “[[category.nursing]]”, then to “[[category.admin]]”.
Sign in as test.phc.requester, choose “[[category.medical]]” and read the panel.
exp: Nicosia, medical: six steps, all “[[tracker.state.pending]]”. Step 3 lists [[role.sci_director]], [[role.dir_hr_officer]] and [[role.dir_exec]]. Step 5 lists [[role.medical_director]].
Nursing: step 5 lists [[role.nursing_director]].
Administrative: step 5 shows “[[tracker.not_applicable]]”.
Primary Health Care, medical: step 3 has no [[role.sci_director]] (the Directorate has none) and step 5 lists [[role.medical_director]].

form_draft.title: Save a partly filled draft and open it again
steps: Press “[[list.new]]”. Fill only the facility and the category.
Press “[[action.save_draft]]”.
Open the tab “[[list.tab.mine]]” and look at the row.
Press the row. Fill the rest of the form and press “[[action.save_draft]]” again.
exp: “[[form.draft_saved]]” shows and the page “[[form.title.edit]]” opens. Fields that are not filled do not block a draft.
The list row has no number. It shows the chip “[[status.draft]]”.
Pressing the row opens the draft for editing, with the values saved so far.
The draft has no number until it is submitted.

form_validation.title: Submit checks every field and keeps what you typed
steps: Press “[[form.submit]]” with nothing filled in.
Choose the category “[[category.medical]]” and the reason “[[reason.retirement]]”. Type 0 in “[[field.positions_count]]”.
Type the leaving date 2027-03-01 (wrong format) and press “[[form.submit]]”.
Fix the date to 01/03/2027, leave the leaver name empty and press “[[form.submit]]”.
exp: A red box says “[[validation.summary]]” and lists each field with its message: “[[validation.choose]]” for lists, “[[validation.min_one]]” for the number of posts, “[[validation.required]]” for text fields.
Zero posts gives “[[validation.min_one]]”.
The wrong date gives “[[validation.date]]”.
An empty leaver name gives “[[validation.required]]”. Everything you typed is still in the form. No number is given and nothing is submitted.

docs_upload.title: Add supporting documents to a draft
docs_upload.pre: A draft from the case “Save a partly filled draft”. Have five small files ready: a PDF, a .docx, an .xlsx, a .png and a .jpg.
steps: Open the draft. Look at the section “[[docs.title]]”.
Press “[[docs.choose]]” and select all five files. Look at the list under the button.
Press “[[docs.upload]]”.
Look at the document list.
exp: The page says “[[docs.allowed|n=20]]”. The chosen files are listed with their size before you send them.
The message “[[docs.added.many|n=5]]” shows.
The documents are grouped under “[[page.round|n=1]]”. Each shows its name, size, your name and the time, with the buttons “[[docs.view]]”, “[[docs.download]]” and “[[docs.remove]]”.
(On a brand new form that has not been saved, the section only says “[[docs.draft_first]]”.)

docs_refused.title: Documents that are refused
docs_refused.pre: A draft is open. Have these files: notes.txt (plain text), a text file renamed to fake.pdf, an empty file empty.pdf, and a PDF larger than the file limit (20 MB by default). If you have no large file, ask an administrator to set “[[settings.max_file_mb]]” to 1 under “[[settings.timings]]”, use a 2 MB file, and set it back to 20.
steps: Add notes.txt.
Add fake.pdf.
Add empty.pdf.
Select the large PDF and look at the list under the button, then press “[[docs.upload]]”.
Select a good PDF and notes.txt together and press “[[docs.upload]]”.
exp: notes.txt: “[[docs.error.type|name=notes.txt]]”
fake.pdf (the content is not a PDF): “[[docs.error.type|name=fake.pdf]]”
empty.pdf: “[[docs.error.empty|name=empty.pdf]]”
The large file is flagged in red before sending, and the server also refuses it with “[[docs.error.too_large|name=big.pdf|n=20]]” (the number is the current limit).
In the mixed selection the good PDF is added (“[[docs.added.one]]”) and the other file is refused on its own. Nothing refused appears in the list.

docs_remove.title: When a document can and cannot be removed
docs_remove.pre: A draft with at least two documents. A returned request of this requester (sample request 6, Nicosia medical, returned by the HR officer, is ready; do this case before the resubmit cases).
steps: In the draft press “[[docs.remove]]” next to one document.
Submit the draft. Open the submitted request and look at the document list.
Open sample request 6 and press “[[form.title.resubmit]]”. Look at the document list.
Add a new document there.
exp: In a draft: “[[docs.removed]]” and the document is gone.
After submission the page shows the documents without any “[[docs.remove]]” button.
On the returned request the documents of the earlier round have no “[[docs.remove]]” button.
The new document appears under “[[page.round|n=2]]” and has a “[[docs.remove]]” button until you resubmit.

docs_view.title: Other roles open and download documents
docs_view.pre: A submitted Nicosia request that has a PDF and a Word or Excel document (from the case above).
steps: As test.nic.hr open the request and press “[[docs.view]]” on the PDF.
Press “[[viewer.back]]”. Press “[[docs.view]]” on the Word or Excel document.
Press “[[docs.download]]” on any document.
As test.lim.requester paste the address of the document page from step 1.
exp: The page “[[viewer.title]]” shows the PDF with “[[viewer.page|n=1|total=…]]”, zoom and page buttons.
The Word or Excel file shows as a PDF with “[[viewer.converted]]”, or, if the server cannot convert it, with “[[viewer.no_preview]]”.
The download gives the original file with its original name.
The requester of another Directorate gets “[[error.404]]”. The audit log holds document_view and document_download rows.

submit_ok.title: Submit a request: number, tracker and first task
who: Administrator to read the email log: test.demo.admin
steps: Fill the whole form for a medical request: Nicosia, the first facility, cost centre T-1001, category “[[category.medical]]”, position “Ιατρός Παθολόγος (δοκιμή)”, 1 post, any specialty, reason “[[reason.new_need]]”, text in every text field, “[[answer.no]]” to both yes/no questions.
Press “[[form.submit]]”. Write down the number.
Make and submit a second request (any category). Write down its number.
Look at the request page of the first request as the requester.
As the administrator open “[[nav.settings]]” and “[[settings.outbox]]”.
exp: The request page opens with “[[form.submitted|number=ΑΕΘ-2026-0001]]” (your own number). The number has the form PREFIX-YEAR-NNNN. The prefix is ΑΕΘ.
The second number is exactly one higher than the first.

The chip says “[[status.in_progress]]”. In the tracker step 1 is “[[tracker.state.done]]”, step 2 is “[[tracker.state.current]]” and the line says “[[statusline.waiting_on|who=[[role.dir_accountant]] (name)]]” with “[[statusline.days.many|n=0]]”.
The requester has no action card and no edit button. The request is no longer a draft.
The email log holds two emails for each request: one to the requester and one to test.nic.accountant.

med_step2_ok.title: Step 2 (medical): check with financial data, then Pass
med_step2_ok.pre: A submitted medical Nicosia request at step 2.
steps: Open the request from the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]”. Find the card “[[action.title]]”.
Answer “[[card.position_available]]” with “[[answer.yes]]” and “[[card.funds_available]]” with “[[answer.yes]]”. Press “[[card.send]]” without financial data.
In “[[card.fin.title]]” choose a specialty. Type the month 09/2026 in “[[card.fin.payroll_period|month=mm/yyyy]]”, and 08/2026 in “[[card.fin.data_to|month=mm/yyyy]]”.
Under “[[card.fin.prev_year]]” type visits 48.200, procedures 9.350, revenue 1.254.300,50, payroll 812.400,00, headcount 14. Under “[[card.fin.ytd]]” type 37.900, 7.120, 988.250,00, 603.100,00, 14,5.
Change the first answer to “[[answer.arranged_centrally]]” and press “[[card.send]]”.
exp: Step 2 without figures: the card shows “[[error.financials_required]]” and nothing changes.
While you type revenue and payroll the line “[[card.fin.ratio]]” fills in: 1,54 for the previous year and 1,64 for the year to date.
The note under the figures says “[[card.fin.source.manual]]”.

After sending: “[[done.check]]”. Step 2 is “[[tracker.state.done]]” and step 3 is “[[tracker.state.current]]” with [[role.sci_director]] and [[role.dir_hr_officer]] “[[tracker.state.waiting]]” ([[role.dir_exec]] waits for them).
Under “[[page.checks]]” the accountant's answer and the financial table appear.

med_step2_reject.title: Step 2: “No” rejects the request and needs a comment
med_step2_reject.pre: A submitted Nicosia request at step 2 (any category).
steps: Answer “[[card.position_available]]” with “[[answer.no]]” and leave the comment empty. Press “[[card.send]]”.
Write a comment, press “[[card.send]]”.
Open the request as the requester.
Repeat the whole case on another request with “[[card.funds_available]]” answered “[[answer.no]]” (and the position “[[answer.yes]]”).
exp: Without a comment the card shows “[[error.comment_required]]” and the answer is not sent.
With a comment: “[[done.check]]”. The status is “[[status.rejected]]”.

The tracker shows step 2 as “[[tracker.stopped_here]]” and the accountant's answer as “[[tracker.state.negative]]”. A banner says “[[closed.rejected_at|n=2|step=[[step.2]]|who=[[role.dir_accountant]] (name)]]” with the comment. The requester sees the same.
A “[[answer.no]]” to the funds question rejects in the same way. No task stays open, and the requester gets an email labelled “[[mail.status.problem]]”.

med_step3_inputs.title: Step 3: the two inputs in any order, then the decision
med_step3_inputs.pre: A medical Nicosia request at step 3 (use the one from the step 2 case).
steps: As test.nic.exec open the request.
As test.nic.sci answer “[[card.opinion]]” with “[[opinion.negative]]” and a comment. Press “[[card.send]]”.
Open the request as test.nic.exec again, then as the requester.
As test.nic.hr answer “[[card.documentation]]” with “[[documentation.complete]]”. Press “[[card.send]]”.
Open the request as test.nic.exec.
exp: Step 1: the Executive Director has no card yet.
Step 2: “[[done.opinion]]”. A negative opinion does not stop the request. The Executive Director still has no card.
The requester sees only “[[tracker.state.negative]]” for the Scientific Director, not the comment.
Step 4: “[[done.check]]”. Step 3 stays the current step, and the Executive Director is now “[[tracker.state.waiting]]”.
Step 5: the Executive Director sees a card with “[[action.approve]]” and “[[action.reject]]”, and the request is on the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]”.

med_exec.title: Step 3 decision: approve and reject
who: Requester, accountant and HR officer of Primary Health Care: test.phc.requester, test.phc.accountant, test.phc.hr
med_exec.pre: Make two administrative requests for Primary Health Care and bring both to the Executive Director: accountant Yes and Yes, HR officer “[[documentation.complete]]”.
steps: On request A press “[[action.approve]]” (comment empty).
On request B press “[[action.reject]]” with the comment empty.
On request B write a comment and press “[[action.reject]]”.
exp: A: “[[done.approve]]”. Step 3 is “[[tracker.state.done]]” and step 4 is “[[tracker.state.current]]” with [[role.fin_mgmt_head]] and [[role.central_hr_officer]] “[[tracker.state.waiting]]”. Both get a task at the same time.
B without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”.
B with a comment: “[[done.reject]]”. The status is “[[status.rejected]]” and the banner says “[[closed.rejected_at|n=3|step=[[step.3]]|who=[[role.dir_exec]] (name)]]”.

med_credit_no.title: Step 4: “No credit” rejects at once
med_credit_no.pre: An administrative Primary Health Care request at step 4 (both central tasks open).
steps: As test.central.finmgmt answer “[[card.credit]]” with “[[answer.no]]” and no comment. Press “[[card.send]]”.
Write a comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
As test.central.hr look at the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]” and open the request.
exp: Without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”.
With a comment: “[[done.check]]”. The request is “[[status.rejected]]” with the banner “[[closed.rejected_at|n=4|step=[[step.4]]|who=[[role.fin_mgmt_head]] (name)]]”.
The other officer's task closed by itself: the request is not on that officer's “[[list.tab.waiting]]” tab and the page has no card.

med_step4_ok.title: Step 4: credit and costs, then the next step
med_step4_ok.pre: A medical Nicosia request with the reason “[[reason.retirement]]” and one leaver, at step 4.
steps: As test.central.finmgmt answer “[[card.credit]]” with “[[answer.yes]]”, leave “[[card.commitment_article]]” empty and press “[[card.send]]”.
Type 2.1.05.001 as the commitment article and press “[[card.send]]”.
As test.central.hr look at the fields, then press “[[card.send]]” empty.
Type abc in the new hires field and press “[[card.send]]”.
Type 48.500,00 for the leaver and 52.000,00 for the new hires. Press “[[card.send]]”.
exp: Step 1: “[[error.commitment_article_required]]”.
Step 2: “[[done.check]]”. Step 4 stays current until the other officer answers (the order of the two does not matter).
Step 3: one field “[[card.leaver_cost|name=(leaver name)]]” and one field “[[card.new_hire_cost]]”. An empty send gives “[[error.leaver_costs_required]]”.
Step 4: “[[validation.amount]]”.
Step 5: after both answers step 4 is “[[tracker.state.done]]” and step 5 is current with [[role.medical_director]] waiting.

med_step5.title: Step 5: the specialty opinion
med_step5.pre: The medical request from the step 4 case, now at step 5.
steps: Open the request and choose “[[opinion.negative]]” with no comment. Press “[[card.send]]”.
Write a comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
exp: Without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”.
With a comment: “[[done.opinion]]”. A negative opinion does not stop the request: step 6 becomes current and [[role.ceo]] is waiting.

med_ceo_approve.title: Step 6: the CEO approves
med_ceo_approve.pre: A request waiting for the CEO (sample request 3, Primary Health Care administrative, is ready; or the case above).
steps: Open the request and press “[[action.approve]]”.
Look at the request page and the tracker.
Open the request as the requester.
exp: “[[done.approve]]”. The chip is “[[status.approved]]” and the page shows the banner “[[done.approve]]”.
All six steps are “[[tracker.state.done]]”. Nobody has an action card or a “[[action.withdraw]]” button.
The requester gets an email labelled “[[mail.status.done]]”.

med_ceo_reject.title: Step 6: the CEO rejects
med_ceo_reject.pre: A request waiting for the CEO.
steps: Press “[[action.reject]]” with the comment empty.
Write a comment and press “[[action.reject]]”.
exp: Without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”.

With a comment: “[[done.reject]]”. The status is “[[status.rejected]]”, the banner says “[[closed.rejected_at|n=6|step=[[step.6]]|who=[[role.ceo]] (name)]]” with the comment, and the requester gets an email labelled “[[mail.status.problem]]”.

nursing_route.title: Nursing request from start to approval
steps: As the requester submit a nursing request in Nicosia: position “Νοσηλευτής/τρια (δοκιμή)”, reason “[[reason.resignation]]” with one leaver.
As the accountant open the card. Answer Yes and Yes.
As the Scientific Director give a positive opinion; as the HR officer answer Complete; as the Executive Director approve.
As the central finance officer answer credit Yes with a commitment article; as the central HR officer give the leaver cost and the new hire cost.
Look at who has a task at step 5, then answer as that person. Finally the CEO approves.
exp: The accountant's card has no “[[card.fin.title]]” section, and “[[page.checks]]” never shows financial data (R2: only medical and allied).
Step 3 asks [[role.sci_director]] and [[role.dir_hr_officer]] (R1), then [[role.dir_exec]].
Step 5 goes to [[role.nursing_director]] (R3). test.central.medical has no task and sees no card.
The request ends “[[status.approved]]”.

admin_route.title: Administrative request from start to approval
steps: As test.phc.requester submit an administrative request: reason “[[reason.new_need]]”. Read the route on the request page.
As the accountant answer Yes and Yes.
Look at who has a task in step 3. Answer as that person, then as the Executive Director.
Answer step 4 as the two central officers (new hire cost only).
Look at the tracker, then approve as the CEO.
exp: Step 2 has no financial data. Step 5 shows “[[tracker.not_applicable]]” from the start.
Step 3 has only [[role.dir_hr_officer]] as input (Primary Health Care has no Scientific Director) and then [[role.dir_exec]].
The central HR card asks only for “[[card.new_hire_cost]]” (a new need has no leaver).
After step 4 the request goes straight to step 6 and [[role.ceo]]. It ends “[[status.approved]]”.

route_variants.title: Route variants: Directorate without Scientific Director, allied health, other
route_variants.pre: None. You only need to reach the end of step 2 and read the tracker.
steps: As test.phc.requester submit a medical request. As test.phc.accountant open the card.
Answer Yes, Yes with financial data. Read step 3 and step 5 in the tracker.
As test.nic.requester submit an allied health request (position “Φυσικοθεραπευτής/τρια (δοκιμή)”). As the accountant answer without data, then with data.
As test.nic.requester submit a request with the category “[[category.other]]”. As the accountant answer Yes and Yes.
exp: Medical in Primary Health Care: the card has the financial table (R2). Step 3 has only [[role.dir_hr_officer]] (R1 needs a Directorate with a Scientific Director). Step 5 is [[role.medical_director]] (R3).
Allied health in Nicosia: the financial table is required (“[[error.financials_required]]” without it), step 3 has [[role.sci_director]], step 5 is [[role.medical_director]].
Other: no financial table, no [[role.sci_director]], step 5 “[[tracker.not_applicable]]”.

return_ok.title: Return a request to the requester
return_ok.pre: A medical Nicosia request at step 3 where the Scientific Director has answered and the HR officer has not.
steps: As test.nic.hr press “[[action.return]]” (the button under the card). Leave the comment empty and confirm.
Write a comment and confirm.
Open the request as test.nic.hr, then as test.nic.sci, then as the requester.
exp: Without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”. The question says “[[card.return.confirm|who=(requester name)]]”.
With a comment: “[[done.return]]”. The chip is “[[status.returned]]”.
Step 3 shows “[[tracker.on_hold]]”. The HR officer's own task is on hold too and the page shows “[[tracker.on_hold]]” instead of a card. The Scientific Director has no card.

The requester sees a yellow box “[[statusline.returned]]” with who returned it, the date, the comment and the button “[[form.title.resubmit]]”, and the line “[[form.days_left.many|n=30]]” (the number is working days left, 30 on the first day).

The requester gets an email labelled “[[mail.status.action]]”. No approver can act while the request is returned. A card sent from a page that was open before the return shows “[[error.request_returned]]”.

resubmit_same.title: Resubmit without a material change
resubmit_same.pre: The returned request from the case above.
steps: As the requester press “[[form.title.resubmit]]”. Look at the Directorate field.
Change only the text “[[field.need_text]]”. Leave “[[form.resubmit_note]]” empty and press “[[action.resubmit]]”.
Type a note and press “[[action.resubmit]]”.
Open the request as test.nic.hr, then as test.nic.sci.
exp: The Directorate is shown as locked text, not as a list (the Directorate can never change).
The empty note gives “[[validation.required]]”.
“[[done.resubmit]]” shows. The status is “[[status.in_progress]]”, step 3 is current again, and the History shows “[[page.round|n=2]]”.
The HR officer's task is back with a card. The Scientific Director, who had answered, sees “[[card.replace.intro]]” with “[[action.keep_answer]]” and the answer form.
Emails go to the people whose task resumed or who can replace an answer.

keep_answer.title: Keep an earlier answer after resubmission
keep_answer.pre: The request from the case above, after resubmission.
steps: Open the request. Press “[[action.keep_answer]]”.
Open the request again.
exp: “[[done.keep_answer]]” shows. The card disappears and the earlier opinion stays as it was.
There is no second chance to change it; the History has no new answer.

replace_answer.title: Replace an earlier answer after resubmission
replace_answer.pre: Part A: a Nicosia request at step 3 resubmitted after a return, with a positive opinion from the Scientific Director. Part B: a nursing request at step 4 where [[role.fin_mgmt_head]] answered credit Yes and [[role.central_hr_officer]] returned the request; the requester resubmitted it.
steps: Part A: as test.nic.sci choose “[[opinion.negative]]” in the answer form, with a comment, and press “[[card.send]]”.
Part A: open the request and read “[[page.checks]]” and “[[page.history]]”.
Part B: as test.central.finmgmt choose “[[answer.no]]” for credit with no comment, then with a comment.
exp: Part A: “[[done.opinion]]”. “[[page.checks]]” shows the new value with “[[tracker.replaced]]”. The History marks the old entry “[[history.superseded]]”. Nothing else moves.
Part B without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”.
Part B with a comment: the request is “[[status.rejected]]” at step 4 at once (the new “[[answer.no]]” counts like a first one).

resubmit_material.title: Resubmit with a material change goes back to step 2
resubmit_material.pre: A returned medical Nicosia request that has answers from step 2 and step 3.
steps: As the requester press “[[form.title.resubmit]]”.
Change the category to “[[category.admin]]” and choose an administrative position. Write the note and press “[[action.resubmit]]”.
Read the tracker and the History. Open the request as test.nic.accountant and as test.nic.sci.
exp: The request is “[[status.in_progress]]” at step 2 (not at the step where it was returned), in “[[page.round|n=2]]”.
The route is worked out again: step 5 is “[[tracker.not_applicable]]” and there is no [[role.sci_director]].
The History keeps every earlier entry from step 2 on, marked “[[history.superseded]]”.
[[role.dir_accountant]] has a card again. The tasks of the others closed: test.nic.sci sees no card.
The same happens when the facility, the cost centre, the position or the number of posts changes. A change of text only does not (case “Resubmit without a material change”).

withdraw_ok.title: The requester withdraws a request
withdraw_ok.pre: A request in progress, and a returned request (both of this requester).
steps: Open the request in progress. Press “[[action.withdraw]]” (below the page).
Press the same button in the panel with the comment empty.
Write a comment and press it again.
Open the request as test.nic.accountant.
Repeat steps 1 to 3 on the returned request.
exp: The panel asks “[[card.withdraw.confirm]]” and “[[card.comment_required]]”.
Without a comment: “[[error.comment_required]]”.
With a comment: “[[done.withdraw]]”. The chip is “[[status.withdrawn]]” and the banner says “[[closed.withdrawn_by_requester]]” with the comment.
The accountant has no card and the request left the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]”. The accountant gets an email “[[mail.request_withdrawn.intro]]”; the requester does not get one.
A returned request can be withdrawn in the same way. A closed request has no “[[action.withdraw]]” button.

auto_withdraw.title: Automatic withdrawal of a returned request
who: Server administrator to run the timers
auto_withdraw.pre: Needs a server administrator. A returned request that is not resubmitted. The administrator runs, on the server, “scripts/ehire-cli.sh run-timers --at <date and time>” (see docs/operations.md). The rules count working days, so the dates are about 25 and 50 days after the return. Real waiting would take 15 and 30 working days.
steps: Return a request (as in the case “Return a request”). Write down the date.
The administrator runs run-timers with a time 25 days later (for example 2026-12-18T09:00:00+02:00).
Open the request as the requester and read the email log.
The administrator runs run-timers with a time 50 days after the return.
Open the request as the requester.
exp: Step 2: the command prints “warnings=” with at least 1 and “withdrawn=0”.

Step 3: the request is still “[[status.returned]]”. The requester has an email labelled “[[mail.status.action]]” saying the request will be withdrawn automatically in a number of working days if it is not resubmitted.
Step 4: the command prints “withdrawn=” with at least 1.

Step 5: the chip is “[[status.withdrawn]]”, the banner says “[[closed.withdrawn_by_system]]”, and the History says “[[history.withdraw_system|n=30]]”. The requester gets an email with the text “[[system.auto_withdraw]]”.

ooo_new.title: Out of office: new tasks go to the substitute
steps: As test.nic.accountant open the list and find the panel “[[ooo.title]]”. Press “[[ooo.switch_on]]” without dates.
As the requester submit a new Nicosia request.
As test.nic.deputy open the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]” and the request.
As test.nic.accountant open the same request.
As the deputy answer the card. Read the History.
exp: The panel first says “[[ooo.off]]” with the substitute's name. After the press: “[[ooo.saved_on]]”.
The request goes to the deputy: the tracker and the card say “[[tracker.acting_for|who=(deputy)|holder=(accountant)]]” with “[[tracker.redirect.out_of_office]]”.
The accountant has no card on it.
The History shows the same “for” line for the deputy's answer.
The requester and the deputy see no “[[ooo.title]]” panel (only holders of an approver role have it).

ooo_move.title: Out of office moves open tasks; coming back does not move them back
ooo_move.pre: test.nic.accountant has at least two open tasks (submit two Nicosia requests as test.nic.requester while the accountant is in the office).
steps: Press “[[ooo.switch_on]]”.
In the panel type the end date 01/12/2026 and the start date 10/12/2026, then press the button. Then type a date in a wrong format.
Press “[[ooo.switch_off]]”.
Open the two requests. Submit a third request and look at its task.
exp: “[[ooo.saved_on]]” and “[[ooo.moved.many|n=2|who=(deputy)]]”. Both requests now wait on the deputy.
An end date before the start date gives “[[ooo.invalid_dates]]”. A wrong format gives “[[validation.date]]”.
“[[ooo.saved_off]]”. The two tasks stay with the deputy.
The third request goes to the accountant again.

conflict.title: Conflict of interest: the holder made the request
conflict.pre: None. test.lar.sci holds two roles in Larnaca – Famagusta.
steps: As test.lar.sci submit a medical request for Larnaca – Famagusta.
As test.lar.accountant answer Yes and Yes with financial data.
Open the request as test.lar.deputy and as test.lar.sci. Look at the email log (administrator).
Part B: as test.central.hr submit an administrative request for Nicosia. Take it through steps 2 and 3 with the Nicosia accounts. Look at who has the task of [[role.central_hr_officer]] in step 4.
exp: Step 3 of the tracker shows [[role.sci_director]] with “[[tracker.acting_for|who=(deputy)|holder=(test.lar.sci)]]” and “[[tracker.redirect.conflict_of_interest]]”.
test.lar.deputy has the card. test.lar.sci, the requester, has none.
The requester gets an email “[[mail.task_redirected.intro.conflict_of_interest|who=(deputy)]]”.
Part B: the [[role.central_hr_officer]] task goes to test.central.deputy, “for” test.central.hr, with the same “[[tracker.redirect.conflict_of_interest]]” note.

unassigned.title: A role with nobody: the task stays unassigned
unassigned.pre: The Directorates Mental Health and Ambulance Service have no role holders and no requesters.
steps: As the administrator open “[[nav.settings]]”, “[[settings.roles]]”, the group Mental Health (test), and add test.nic.requester under “[[role.requester]]” with “[[settings.add]]”.
As test.nic.requester submit an administrative request for Mental Health (test).
Open the request and the email log (administrator).
As the administrator set a holder for [[role.dir_accountant]] of Mental Health (test) and press the button “[[settings.reassign|n=1]]”.
Remove test.nic.requester from the Mental Health requesters when you finish.
exp: Step 2: the request is submitted; step 2 is current and the line says “[[statusline.waiting_on|who=[[role.dir_accountant]]]]” with no name. Nobody has a card.
The email log has a mail to the administrator labelled “[[mail.status.problem]]” with “[[mail.task_unassigned.intro|role=[[role.dir_accountant]]]]”.
Setting the holder does not move the task by itself. The button offers to move 1 task. After pressing it the new holder has the task.

only_assignee.title: Only the current assignee can act
only_assignee.pre: A Nicosia request at step 2. Two browser tabs for test.nic.accountant.
steps: Open the request in tab 1 and tab 2 as test.nic.accountant.
In tab 1 answer Yes and Yes (administrative request) and send.
In tab 2 (the old page) press “[[card.send]]”.
Open the same request as test.nic.hr, test.nic.requester and test.demo.viewer while it is at step 2 (use a new request for this).
exp: Tab 2 shows “[[error.not_your_task]]” with the request in its current state. Nothing is recorded twice.
The HR officer, the requester and the viewer see the request but no card while the task is the accountant's. The requester who tries to act gets “[[error.own_request]]”.

o4_opinions.title: A comment is required for negative opinions and an incomplete file
o4_opinions.pre: Requests at step 3 inputs and at step 5 (from the medical case).
steps: As test.nic.sci choose “[[opinion.negative]]” with no comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
As test.nic.hr choose “[[documentation.incomplete]]” with no comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
As test.central.medical choose “[[opinion.negative]]” with no comment and press “[[card.send]]”.
Repeat each with a comment. Then try a positive opinion and “[[documentation.complete]]” with no comment.
exp: Without a comment the browser shows “[[error.comment_required]]” and does not send. If it is sent anyway the server answers the same.
With a comment each answer is recorded (“[[done.opinion]]”, “[[done.check]]”).
A positive opinion and “[[documentation.complete]]” need no comment.

o4_decisions.title: A comment is required for reject, return and withdraw
o4_decisions.pre: A request at the Directorate decision, one at the CEO, and one in progress of the requester. “No” answers at steps 2 and 4 are covered in the cases for those steps.
steps: As the Executive Director press “[[action.reject]]” with no comment.
As the CEO press “[[action.reject]]” with no comment.
As any approver press “[[action.return]]” and confirm with no comment.
As the requester press “[[action.withdraw]]” and confirm with no comment.
Press “[[action.approve]]” with no comment on a request at the Directorate decision.
exp: Steps 1 to 4: “[[error.comment_required]]”, and the request does not change.
Step 5: the approval is accepted without a comment.

vis_requester.title: A requester sees only their own requests, and only outcomes
vis_requester.pre: The sample requests are loaded. A request of test.nic.requester that has answers with comments (use the one from the step 3 case).
steps: As test.nic.requester open the tab “[[list.tab.all]]”.
As test.phc.requester open the same tab.
As test.nic.requester open a request that has answers. Read “[[page.checks]]”.
Read the comments you can see on a returned or rejected request.
exp: Each requester sees only the requests they made (the tab “[[list.tab.all]]” holds the same as “[[list.tab.mine]]”).
“[[page.checks]]” shows for each role only “[[tracker.state.done]]” or “[[tracker.state.negative]]”, with no answers, figures or approver comments.
A comment is shown to the requester only on a return, a rejection or a withdrawal.

vis_404.title: A request outside your scope answers “not found”
steps: As test.lim.requester open one of the requests and note the number at the end of the address (for example /requests/5). Create a draft and note its address too.
As test.nic.requester paste the first address, then the draft address.
Paste an address with a number that does not exist (for example /requests/99999).
exp: All three show “[[error.404]]”. The page does not say that the request exists, and the status is 404, not “forbidden”.
The same holds for the address of a document of that request.

vis_directorate.title: Directorate holders and substitutes see their own Directorate
vis_directorate.pre: The sample requests are loaded. test.nic.requester has a draft.
steps: As test.nic.accountant open the tab “[[list.tab.all]]”.
As test.nic.deputy open the same tab.
As test.lim.accountant open the same tab.
Look for the draft of test.nic.requester as test.nic.accountant.
exp: test.nic.accountant sees the Nicosia requests (samples 2, 6 and 7 and any new ones) and none of Limassol.
The substitute sees the same Nicosia requests.
test.lim.accountant sees only Limassol requests (samples 1, 4 and 5).
Nobody but the requester sees a draft.

vis_roles.title: Central roles, viewer and administrator: what each can see and do
steps: As test.central.ceo, test.demo.viewer and test.demo.admin open the tab “[[list.tab.all]]”.
As the viewer and the administrator look for the button “[[list.new]]” and type /requests/new in the address bar.
As the viewer open a request that waits for someone.
As test.nic.requester and test.nic.accountant type /settings and /audit in the address bar. Do the same as the administrator.
exp: All three see every submitted request of every Directorate, and no drafts. The viewer's first tab is “[[list.tab.mine]]”, which is empty; “[[list.tab.all]]” has the requests.
The viewer and the administrator have no “[[list.new]]” button; /requests/new shows “[[error.404]]”.
The viewer sees no action card.
Requester and accountant get “[[error.404]]” for /settings and /audit. The administrator opens both and has “[[nav.audit]]” and “[[nav.settings]]” in the menu.

list_tabs.title: The three tabs and their empty messages
steps: As test.central.ceo open “[[list.tab.waiting]]”.
As test.central.finmgmt open “[[list.tab.waiting]]”.
As test.nic.requester open “[[list.tab.waiting]]”.
As test.demo.viewer open “[[list.tab.mine]]”.
Press a row in any list. Look at the chip and the small tracker in a row.
exp: The CEO sees sample request 3 (administrative, Primary Health Care). The finance officer sees sample request 2 (nursing, Nicosia).
The requester sees “[[list.empty.waiting]]”. The viewer sees “[[list.empty.mine]]”. A search with no result shows “[[list.empty.all]]”.
Each row shows the number, the position and posts, the facility, the cost centre, a status chip, six small stops and the status line. The row opens the request.

list_search.title: Search by number
steps: In “[[list.search]]” type the full number of a request, for example ΑΕΘ-2026-0003.
Type the same number in lower case and without dashes: ehire20260003.
Type only 0003, then 2026, then xyz.
Only if your numbers begin with ΑΕΘ: type AEU-2026-0007 (the Latin U stands for Θ).
exp: Steps 1 and 2 find that one request.
0003 finds that request. 2026 finds every request of the year. xyz shows “[[list.empty.all]]”.
Step 4: the request ΑΕΘ-2026-0007 is found. Requests created before version 1.0.0-rc8 have a number that begins with EHIRE; test with a request that begins with ΑΕΘ.

list_export.title: Export the list to Excel
list_export.pre: The sample requests are loaded. Excel or LibreOffice on your computer.
steps: As test.central.ceo open the tab “[[list.tab.all]]”, search 0003, press “[[list.export]]” and open the file.
Repeat without the search.
As test.nic.accountant export the tab “[[list.tab.all]]”.
Look for the button as test.nic.requester.
In the file change a status in the Requests sheet and look at the Summary sheet.
exp: The file is named eHire-requests-YYYYMMDD.xlsx with three sheets: “[[export.sheet.requests]]”, “[[export.sheet.summary]]” and “[[export.sheet.notes]]”.
With the search only that request is in the file; without it every request the user may see. test.nic.accountant gets Nicosia rows only.

The columns include “[[export.col.number]]”, “[[export.col.status]]”, “[[export.col.step]]”, “[[export.col.waiting_on]]”, “[[export.col.days_waiting]]”, “[[export.col.round]]” and “[[export.col.documents]]”. There are no leaver names, costs or comments.
The requester has no export button.
The summary is made of formulas: the counts “[[export.summary.by_status]]” change when you edit a row. The notes say who exported and when.

mail_flow.title: Emails during the first steps (read in the email log)
mail_flow.pre: No real email is sent. “[[settings.outbox]]” lists every email with the state “[[settings.outbox.state.queued]]”.
steps: As the requester submit a medical Nicosia request.
As the accountant answer Yes and Yes with financial data.
As the administrator open “[[nav.settings]]” and “[[settings.outbox]]”. Find the mails of this request.
Press “[[settings.outbox.preview]]” on one of them.
exp: After step 1: a mail to the requester (“[[mail.status.info]]”, “[[mail.request_submitted.intro|number=(number)]]”) and a mail to test.nic.accountant (“[[mail.status.action]]”, “[[mail.task_opened.intro|role=[[role.dir_accountant]]]]”).
After step 2: a mail to test.nic.sci and one to test.nic.hr, each “[[mail.status.action]]”.
The subject is “[number] position · facility”. The list line shows the recipient, the time and the label.

The preview shows the logo, the label, a short summary of the request, one button “[[action.view_request]]” and the footer “[[mail.footer]]”. The button address starts with the server address and ends with /requests/<id>?do=review. No other link changes anything.

mail_outcomes.title: Emails for return, resubmission, rejection, approval and withdrawal
who: other accounts as in the earlier cases
mail_outcomes.pre: Requests that went through the return, rejection, approval and withdrawal cases.
steps: Open the email log and find the mails for each event.
Check who got each mail and who did not.
Look at the language of the mail sent to test.demo.admin (case “A role with nobody”) and of the others.
exp: Return: the requester gets “[[mail.status.action]]” with “[[mail.request_returned.intro|who=(name)]]” and the comment.
Resubmission: the person who returned gets “[[mail.status.info]]” (“[[mail.request_resubmitted.intro]]”); a person who may replace an answer gets “[[mail.new_material.intro]]”.
Rejection: the requester gets “[[mail.status.problem]]”. Approval: the requester gets “[[mail.status.done]]”.
Withdrawal by the requester: the people with an open task get “[[mail.request_withdrawn.intro]]”.

Nobody gets a mail about their own action (the only exception is the confirmation of a submission). Each recipient gets the language set on their user: the administrator account is English, the others Greek.

timer_seed.title: A reminder and an escalation already sent (sample request 2)
timer_seed.pre: The sample requests are loaded. Sample request 2 (nursing, Nicosia, resignation) has waited at step 4 for six working days or more. No wait and no administrator command is needed.
steps: As test.central.finmgmt open sample request 2 and read the lines under the tracker.
As the administrator open the email log and look at the mails of that request.
As test.central.ceo (the line manager of both officers) look at the request.
exp: Two lines: “[[statusline.waiting_on|who=[[role.fin_mgmt_head]] (name)]]” and the same for [[role.central_hr_officer]], each with “[[statusline.days.many|n=6]]” (or more), “[[statusline.reminded]]” and “[[statusline.escalated]]”.
The log has a reminder for each officer (“[[mail.status.action]]”) and an escalation for the line manager (“[[mail.status.problem]]”, “[[mail.escalation_due.intro|who=(name)|n=6]]”).
The task stays with the same officers (O5). The escalation moves nothing.

timer_run.title: A new reminder and escalation after working days
timer_run.pre: Needs a server administrator. The administrator runs “scripts/ehire-cli.sh run-timers --at <date and time>” (docs/operations.md). Without the command you would wait 2 and 5 working days. Mail stays in the email log.
steps: Submit a new Nicosia request and write down the date.
The administrator runs run-timers with a time about 3 working days later.
Read the email log and the request page.
The administrator runs the command again with the same time.
The administrator runs it with a time about 8 working days after the submission.
exp: Step 2: the command prints “reminders=” with at least 1. A reminder mail goes to test.nic.accountant (“[[mail.reminder_due.intro.many|n=3]]”, the number is the working days waited). The request page says “[[statusline.reminded]]”.
Step 4: no second reminder (one per clock start).
Step 5: an escalation mail goes to the accountant's line manager, test.nic.exec (“[[mail.escalation_due.intro|who=(accountant)|n=8]]”), and the page says “[[statusline.escalated]]”.
The task stays with the accountant.

timer_workdays.title: Weekends and public holidays do not count as waiting days
timer_workdays.pre: Sample request 2 is waiting at step 4. Look in its History at the date when the Executive Director approved (the step 4 tasks opened then).
steps: As test.central.ceo read the number of days in the status line of sample request 2 (call it N).
As the administrator open “[[settings.holidays]]” and add a date that is a weekday after the approval date and before today, with names in both languages.
Read the status line again.
Remove the holiday you added. Read the status line again.
exp: Step 1: N working days (weekends are never counted).
After the holiday is added the line shows N − 1 days.
After the holiday is removed it shows N again.

set_lists.title: Settings: lists (add, edit, deactivate)
set_lists.pre: Use codes that start with T- and names that end with “(test)”, so the clear-up removes them.
steps: Open “[[nav.settings]]”. Look at the pages and the lists with their counts.
Open “[[settings.list.cost_centre]]”. Add code T-3001 with a Greek and an English name. Press “[[settings.add]]”.
Add code T-1001 again.
Change the English name of T-3001 and press “[[settings.save]]”. Press “[[settings.deactivate]]”.
As test.nic.requester open the form “[[form.title.new]]” and look at the cost centre list. Then activate T-3001 again.
Open “[[settings.list.facility]]” and open the list “[[settings.col.archive_site]]”.
exp: Settings lists: role holders, users, public holidays, times and limits, email log, eArchive deposits, Import from Excel, and the five lists with counts.
A new row: “[[settings.saved]]”. A repeated code: “[[settings.duplicate_code]]”.
Edit: “[[settings.saved]]”. The code cannot be edited after creation.
A deactivated row shows “[[settings.inactive]]” and is missing from the request form; after “[[settings.activate]]” it is back.
The eArchive site list holds only the twelve current codes. Every change has a row in the audit log (list_changed).

set_roles.title: Settings: role holders and substitutes
set_roles.pre: A Nicosia request waiting on test.nic.accountant. Write down who holds the roles before you change anything, and restore them at the end.
steps: Open “[[settings.roles]]”. Look at the groups and at the rows of Primary Health Care.
For [[role.dir_accountant]] of Nicosia choose the same person as holder and substitute and press “[[settings.save]]”.
Choose test.nic.deputy as holder and press “[[settings.save]]”. Open the waiting request as test.nic.accountant.
Press “[[settings.reassign|n=1]]”.
Add test.nic.accountant under the requesters of Nicosia, then remove the entry. Restore the original holder.
exp: The page has the group “[[settings.central]]” and one group per Directorate. The Scientific Director row is missing for a Directorate that has none (Primary Health Care).
Same person: “[[settings.same_person]]”.
After the change the open task stays with the old holder (a change of holder does not reroute a request: R4). The page shows the button “[[settings.reassign|n=1]]”.
After the button the task is with the new holder and a message tells who got it. The new holder gets an email.
Each change has a row in the audit log (role_changed).

set_users.title: Settings: users and the first password change
set_users.pre: New test users must have a username that starts with test. (for example test.uat.one).
steps: Open “[[settings.users]]”. Add test.uat.one with a name, an email ending @test.invalid, the language and a temporary password.
Sign in as test.uat.one with that password. Type two different passwords, then a password shorter than 8 characters, then a good one twice.
Look at the list as the new user.
As the administrator press “[[settings.deactivate]]” for test.uat.one. Try to sign in again.
Try to deactivate your own account. Try to add test.uat.one again.
exp: “[[settings.saved]]”. The row shows “[[settings.user.source.local]]”.
First sign-in goes to “[[password.title]]”. Messages: “[[password.mismatch]]”, “[[password.too_short|n=8]]”. A good password leads to the list.
The new user has no role: an empty list and no menu items.
The deactivated user gets “[[login.failed]]”.
“[[settings.self_deactivate]]” and “[[settings.user.duplicate]]”.

set_timings.title: Settings: times and limits
set_timings.pre: Write down the four values (2, 5, 30 and 20 on a new install) and restore them at the end.
steps: Open “[[settings.timings]]”. Read the four fields and the question “[[settings.activity_provider]]”.
Set “[[settings.reminder_days]]” to 5 and “[[settings.escalation_days]]” to 3. Press “[[settings.save]]”.
Type 0 in one field and the word abc in another. Press “[[settings.save]]”.
Set reminder 1 and escalation 2. Save. Then restore the original values.
exp: The second answer “[[settings.activity_provider.efinance]]” cannot be chosen: it is disabled and the page says “[[settings.activity_provider.not_configured]]”. “[[settings.activity_provider.manual]]” is selected.
Step 2: “[[settings.escalation_order]]”.
Step 3: “[[settings.number_invalid]]” next to each wrong field. Nothing is saved.
Step 4: “[[settings.saved]]”. The audit log holds setting_changed rows with the old and new value.

set_holidays.title: Settings: public holidays
steps: Open “[[settings.holidays]]”. Look at the year buttons.
Add 25/12/2026 with the names Χριστούγεννα and Christmas Day.
Add the same date again.
Add the date 31/02/2026, then a valid date with no English name.
Remove the holiday you added.
exp: The list shows the holidays of the chosen year with the date as dd/mm/yyyy.
“[[settings.saved]]”, then “[[settings.holiday_duplicate]]”.
“[[validation.date]]” and “[[validation.required]]”.
Removal: “[[settings.saved]]”. The audit log holds setting_changed rows.

import_valid.title: Excel import: a valid file
import_valid.pre: Excel or LibreOffice on your computer.
steps: Open “[[import.menu]]” in Settings. Read the steps and rules.
Press “[[import.template.download]]” and open the file.
On the sheet cost_centres add one row: T-3101, a Greek name, an English name ending “(test)”, active yes. Save the file.
Upload it with “[[import.upload.submit]]”. Read the summary.
Press “[[import.confirm]]”.
Upload the same file again.
exp: The page shows “[[import.steps.title]]”, “[[import.rules.title]]” and the limits.
The template has the sheets Instructions, directorates, facilities, positions, cost_centres, oay_specialties, users and role_holders, filled with the present data.
The summary “[[import.preview.title]]” shows one new row for cost_centres and the rest unchanged.
“[[import.done|add=1|update=0]]” and the cost centre is in the list.
The second upload says “[[import.preview.nothing]]”. “[[import.cancel]]” leaves nothing changed.

import_wrong.title: Excel import: a file with one wrong row changes nothing
import_wrong.pre: The template downloaded in the case above.
steps: In cost_centres add two rows: T-3201 (valid), and T-3202 with the Greek name empty and the value maybe in the column active. Save and upload the file.
Look at the cost centre list.
Upload a .txt file, then a file that is not a real workbook renamed to .xlsx.

It lists the sheet, the row number of the bad row and the messages “[[import.err.required]]” (name_el) and “[[import.err.yes_no]]” (active).

audit_view.title: The audit log and its filters
audit_view.pre: Several earlier cases done, so the log has rows.
steps: Press “[[nav.audit]]”. Read the table and the page line.
Filter by a request number, then by a user name, then by an event chosen from the list, then by dates (From 01/01/2027).
Open a request through its number in the table.
Look for a way to edit, delete or export rows.
As test.nic.requester type /audit in the address bar.
exp: The table “[[audit.title]]” has the columns “[[audit.col.when]]”, “[[audit.col.user]]”, “[[audit.col.event]]”, “[[audit.col.request]]” and “[[audit.col.detail]]”, newest first, 50 rows a page, with “[[audit.prev]]” and “[[audit.next]]” and “[[audit.page|n=1|total=…]]”.
The filters narrow the list. A date with nothing in it shows “[[audit.empty]]”. Event names are the technical names (for example login, request_action, mail_queued).
The number opens the request.
The log can only be read. Nothing secret (passwords, tokens) is shown.
The requester gets “[[error.404]]”.

phone_request.title: Phone width: the request page
phone_request.pre: A browser window set to about 375 px wide (phone mode in the developer tools) or a real phone. A request waits for the CEO (sample request 3).
steps: Open the request from the tab “[[list.tab.waiting]]”.
Scroll from the top down to the bottom.
Open the line “[[tracker.title]]”.
exp: The page order is: number and chip, position and facility, the short route (six small stops) and the status line, the card “[[action.title]]”, then the closed line “[[tracker.title]]”, then the details.
No part of the page needs sideways scrolling. Text does not run off the screen.
The buttons are easy to hit (at least about 44 px high).

phone_list_form.title: Phone width: list, form and settings
steps: As test.nic.requester open the list, the tabs and the search.
Open the form “[[form.title.new]]” and scroll to the end.
As the administrator open “[[nav.settings]]”, the email log and the audit log.
exp: List rows are stacked: number, position, facility, status and small route. Tabs and search fit the width.
The form is one column. The route preview comes after the fields. All buttons are reachable.
Settings pages and the audit table can be used. The audit table scrolls inside its own frame, not the whole page.
There is no sideways scrolling on any page you opened.
